hooks.command: FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); case "$FILE" in *.rs) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; DIR=$(dirname "$FILE"); while [ "$DIR" != "/" ] && [ ! -f "$DIR/Cargo.toml" ]; do DIR=$(dirname "$DIR"); done; [ -f "$DIR/Cargo.toml" ] && cd "$DIR" && cargo fmt --all -q 2>&1 || true

CMD=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); run_fix() { TC="+1.91.1"; [ -f rust-toolchain.toml ] && TC=""; cargo $TC fix --allow-dirty --allow-staged; }; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '^cargo (check|clippy|test|build|c|t|b)'; then run_fix; elif echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '^cd .* && cargo (check|clippy|test|build|c|t|b)'; then DIR=$(echo "$CMD" | sed -E 's/^cd ([^ ]*) &&.*/\1/'); if [[ "$DIR" = /* ]]; then cd "$DIR"; else cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/$DIR"; fi && run_fix; fi

CMD=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git commit($|[[:space:]])' || exit 0; DIR="$PWD"; PREFIX_DIR=$(echo "$CMD" | sed -nE 's/^[[:space:]]*cd[[:space:]]+([^ &]+).*/\1/p'); if [ -n "$PREFIX_DIR" ]; then case "$PREFIX_DIR" in /*) DIR="$PREFIX_DIR" ;; *) DIR="$PWD/$PREFIX_DIR" ;; esac; fi; while [ "$DIR" != "/" ] && [ ! -f "$DIR/Cargo.toml" ]; do DIR=$(dirname "$DIR"); done; [ -f "$DIR/Cargo.toml" ] || exit 0; cd "$DIR" || exit 0; TC="+1.91.1"; [ -f rust-toolchain.toml ] && TC=""; OUTPUT=$(cargo $TC clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -q -- -D warnings 2>&1); EXIT=$?; if [ $EXIT -ne 0 ]; then echo "cargo clippy failed - fix warnings before committing:" >&2; echo "$OUTPUT" | tail -50 >&2; exit 2; fi
